bestman-trivia.title: Best Man's Challenge
bestman-trivia.description: How well do you know Ben & Lou?

questions.question: Where did Ben and Lou first meet?
questions.funFact: They were introduced by a mutual friend at a dinner party! The rest is history.

questions.question: What was their first date?
questions.funFact: They took a long walk in the park and talked for hours. Neither wanted the date to end!

questions.question: What is Ben & Lou's favorite thing to do together?
questions.funFact: They love exploring new places together! They've already visited 10 countries.

questions.question: What pet do Ben and Lou have?
questions.funFact: Max is a golden retriever who loves belly rubs and stealing socks!

questions.question: How did Ben propose to Lou?
questions.funFact: Ben proposed during a sunset walk on the beach. Lou said yes before he even finished asking!
